description: This file defines the User model class for the Opencart admin module. It provides methods for managing user data, including create, read, update, delete operations, authentication tokens, login records, and authorization info. It handles interactions with the database for user-related functionalities.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Model class for managing user data in the Opencart admin module.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: editUser
methods.description: Updates the user record identified by user_id with new data.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Updates the password for the specified user.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes the user record and related authorizations and logins.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves user details by user_id.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves user details by username.

methods.name: getUserByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves user details by email address.

methods.name: getUserByCode
methods.description: Retrieves user details by code.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users based on filter criteria.

methods.name: getTotalUsers
methods.description: Returns the total count of users matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalUsersByGroupId
methods.description: Returns the total number of users in a specific user group.

methods.name: getTotalUsersByEmail
methods.description: Returns the total number of users with a given email.

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Records a login attempt for a user.

methods.name: deleteLogins
methods.description: Deletes all login records for a user.

methods.name: getLogins
methods.description: Retrieves login records for a user.

methods.name: getTotalLogins
methods.description: Gets the count of login records for a user.

methods.name: addAuthorize
methods.description: Creates a new authorization record for a user.

methods.name: editAuthorizeStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a user authorization.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotal
methods.description: Updates the total attempts for a specific authorization record.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotalByUserId
methods.description: Updates total attempts for a user based on user_id.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Deletes authorization records for a user.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Retrieves an authorization record by ID.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Retrieves authorization info by user ID and token.

methods.name: getAuthorizes
methods.description: Retrieves multiple authorization records for a user.

methods.name: getTotalAuthorizes
methods.description: Returns total authorization records for a user.

methods.name: resetAuthorizes
methods.description: Resets the authorization total count for a user.

methods.name: addToken
methods.description: Generates a token record for a user.

methods.name: getTokenByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a token record by code, with expiry check.

methods.name: deleteTokenByCode
methods.description: Deletes a token record by code.
